headline: HI-LEX Corporation Files Regulatory Update on Cyber Incident
body: HI-LEX Corporation has filed a regulatory update detailing a recent cyberattack that impacted its operations. The automotive components supplier reported that it had to isolate servers and temporarily halt production and order-processing systems. The filing confirms that a ransom demand was made by the attackers. HI-LEX Corporation is actively working with incident responders to restore affected systems and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. The company remains focused on resuming normal operations.
